name: Intake Stairs
description: Stone steps ascending into bureaucratic authority. Fluorescent panels hum. A sign reads: ALL ENTRY REQUIRES PROCESSING. Your heart learns the weight of procedure.

special_commands.feel_pressure: The pressure of bureaucratic gravity increases.

name: Number Desk
description: A small desk with a tired clerk and a machine that dispenses numbers. The queue spiral begins here. Without a number, progress becomes noise.

special_commands.take_number: You take a queue_slip from the dispenser. You are now numbered.
special_commands.talk_clerk: The clerk looks up: Queue is order. Order is law.

name: Queue Spine
description: The central spine of bureaucratic ritual. A spiral of corded lines. People stand in ordered silence. The air tastes of time. To move forward, you queue.

special_commands.queue: You join the line. The ritual accepts you.

name: Form Window
description: A window with a clerk distributing blank forms. Form 27b sits in neat stacks. These forms are your path forward—once you understand what they mean.

special_commands.take_form: You take a blank_form_27b. It is heavy with possibility and regulation.
special_commands.read_form: The form demands completion. Every line is mandatory.

name: Denial Bay
description: A stark room where forms are examined and returned with a single word: DENIED. This is where denial becomes procedural. You will learn its texture.

special_commands.submit_form: Your form is examined. The clerk marks it DENIED.
special_commands.appeal_denial: You file an appeal. The denial becomes a stage, not an ending.

name: Goblin Annex
description: A chaos-scented room where goblins organize paperwork in intentionally destructive ways. Rules bend here. Forms are loose. Destruction is a kind of progress.

special_commands.scream_at_bureaucracy: The goblin pauses in its destruction. You have spoken its language.
special_commands.take_misfiled_memo: You find a misfiled_memo among the chaos. Someone important lost this.

name: Lost Records
description: An archive of files that were filed incorrectly, lost deliberately, or hidden by the system itself. Records moth tends them. Here, the unfiled become accessible. Here, investigation yields truth.

special_commands.ask_chicken_legal_advice: The chicken pecks advice. The moth guides you to the correct cabinet.
special_commands.investigate: You search the records. The moth's wings settle on useful documents.

name: Frank Outer Desk
description: Frank's domain. The desk is massive, organized, and final. Frank sits behind it with the patience of someone who has denied a thousand forms and will deny a thousand more. Here, reputation matters. Your paperwork arrives with Frank's judgment.
short_description: Where the final word is spoken.

special_commands.talk_frank: Frank regards you. His reputation of you is calculated.
special_commands.stamp_form: You attempt to stamp your form. Frank's reaction depends on his view of you.
special_commands.ask_frank_about_forms: All things must pass through the Desk.
special_commands.ask_frank_about_appeal: Denial is not the end of a form. It is a stage.

name: Stamp Sanctum
description: A sacred room where official stamps rest. The air is thick with formality. Here, forms become official. Here, ink becomes law.

special_commands.take_stamp: You take a provisional_stamp. It feels like borrowed authority.
special_commands.stamp_form: You stamp. The form becomes official in the eyes of the unprepared.

name: Gate Review
description: The final gate. Your paperwork is examined. Your path forward is decided. The chapter ends here. What you have done, what you have learned, what you have become—it is all measured at this desk.
short_description: The end point of bureaucratic passage.

special_commands.present_paperwork: Your paperwork is reviewed. Your fate is decided.
